method: claude -p scored a seeded sample of real donor posts; lexicon verified verbatim in the sample; exemplars = top judge-scored posts with professional >= 4; exemplars exclude template phrasing, first-person experience/positions and trade language
use: voice signature (descriptive): moves, openings, closings and lexicon are tendencies; exemplars teach rhythm only, never facts, numbers or phrases

moves.name: Positioning fact, then the call
moves.how: Name the specific strike, level or vol print, then commit to a trade or target in a few blunt words.

moves.name: Cross-asset divergence
moves.how: Set two markets that usually move together side by side and point out that one isn't reacting (bond vol up while equity vol stays flat).

moves.name: Level as risk line
moves.how: Name the level, say what has to happen at it, and say what makes you a buyer or makes you step aside.

moves.name: Deadpan irony
moves.how: Argue the consensus view to an absurd end in a straight face so the flaw shows, often in one short paragraph.

moves.name: Question, then a one-word verdict
moves.how: Ask a short rhetorical question, then answer it with a single committed word or line.

lexicon: a level to measure risk against
Just focus on the price action
key level of near term interest
openings: A hard number on the tape right now ("SPX lost about 40 points in the last hour...")
A named instrument and what it just did ("$TLT ... has an IV Rank of 100")
A short provocative claim or question ("Front-month NYMEX crude at $76 feels a bit crazy.")
A direct call-out to a group of traders ("HEY CHART SWING TRADERS")
closings: A one-word or one-line position or target ("Bought." / "Pin 6475.")
A conditional trigger for when the view is wrong ("first stress tell is a reclaim through 16.4...")
A short mantra ("Just focus on the price action." / "Only Price Pays!")
A note on what the chart shows ("orange = last 5-days.")
taboos: Product promos, trial links or webinar plugs
Award or gratitude posts and prayer/hype emoji
Profanity or meme greentext with no market content
Corporate hedging that buries the view under caveats
Personal stories unrelated to the tape
Geopolitical rants with no trade attached
donor_first_person: First person is mostly a conviction marker and a risk-discipline frame ("I am not a buyer here until...", "I will only be holding an opinion"), with occasional terse statements of an actual trade ("Bought.") and never used for self-promotion.

exemplars.text:
$VIX 15.40 sits 3.50 pt under the Sep 2 seasonal median (18.90) on a 19y Sep-Oct book, inside P25-P75 (16.4-25.1). Soft payrolls sold the fear bid while $SPX 3M ATM prints 13.3 at the 2nd %ile and $VIX1D holds 13.85 against $VIX1Y 21.93. Seasonal median still climbs into mid-Oct (peak 20.0 near Oct 10) and 17 of 19 years printed an Oct high above the Sep 28 mark. 
Act: fade cheap cash $VIX only while it holds under ~16.4 (P25); first stress tell is a reclaim through 16.4 toward the mid-Oct seasonal path ~20, with $VIX1D losing its discount to spot $VIX.
